title: In this town, every sorry makes you smaller
idea: In this town, every sorry makes you smaller, and makes the one you said it to bigger. Spud says it forty times a day; a big one who never says it pushes in front of him at the bakery.
format: In this town (one strange rule per video, Spud leads, narrator voice 1)

hook.what: two strangers nearly collide in front of a bakery; he says sorry and visibly shrinks

captions.text: In this town, every *sorry* makes you smaller.
And he says it forty times a day.
Say it too often, and you're gone.
But some people never say it.
Every sorry you say... makes *them* bigger.
That's why he's so big. He has *never* said it.
You're in my way. Say sorry.
Oh no! Sorry! Sorry! I'm so sorry!
